name: Khaubalo
backstory: Child of Aurebalo and Khaus; raised in Gorff on takes stonework commissions at the market each morning,..., and carries some knowledge of Birth Of Nakorika.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Birth Of Nakorika
criterion.wasted_life: letting Birth Of Nakorika slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: spends her mornings shadowing the records annex, learning to spot which claims don't match the ledger before anyone has to tell her

arc.premise: Splitting her mornings between the temple's ledger and the market's stalls, Khaubalo has noticed the roof project keeps losing out to the temple's own repair claims for the same timber - she wants a firm material pledge locked in for the market's side before the annex swallows another season's allotment.
